# RageRoom Directory

> The UK's largest independent directory of rage rooms and smash rooms. Compare verified venues by city, see starting prices and packages, and book a destruction-therapy session near you.

RageRoom Directory (rageroomdirectory.co.uk) is an editorial, independent directory. We do not own any of the rage rooms listed; we aggregate, verify and compare them so visitors can find the right venue for stress relief, team-building, birthdays, hen/stag parties and date nights.

All prices are shown in GBP (£). Coverage is UK-wide with strongest depth in London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Newcastle, Sheffield, Bristol, Nottingham, Edinburgh, Leicester, Derby and Brighton.

## Core directory

- [Homepage](https://rageroomdirectory.co.uk/): Search rage rooms by city or postcode; featured venues and editorial guides.
- [All rage rooms in the UK](https://rageroomdirectory.co.uk/listings): Complete directory with filters.
- [Rage room near me](https://rageroomdirectory.co.uk/near-me): Geolocation-based nearest-venue search with interactive map.
- [Search](https://rageroomdirectory.co.uk/search): Keyword search across venues, cities and packages.
- [London interactive map](https://rageroomdirectory.co.uk/london-map): Map view of every London rage room.
